name: Jujutsu (jj)
description: Installs the jj CLI (Jujutsu, a Git-compatible VCS) and the VisualJJ extension, ready to use with no setup: identity and commit signing taken from your git config, your repo turned into a colocated jj repo, jj config kept across rebuilds, and safe defaults when Claude Code or another AI agent runs jj. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

username.description: Container user who uses jj. 'auto' detects vscode/node/codespace/uid-1000, in that order.

version.description: jj version to install: latest, or a release such as 0.46.0.

initRepos.description: Git repos to turn into colocated jj repos (git keeps working in them): workspace = the repo you opened; all = it and every repo next to it, such as org-workspace's; off = none, run `jj git init` yourself.

gitIdentity.description: Give jj the name, email and commit signing of your git config, on every attach. jj doesn't read git's. Your own jj config always wins.

claudeSkill.description: Add a jj skill to Claude Code (when Claude Code is in the container), so it uses jj instead of git in jj repos.
